affirmations.text_en: Your worth is not determined by your appearance, your size, or what you eat.
affirmations.text_es: Tu valor no depende de tu apariencia, tu tamaño, ni de lo que comes.

affirmations.text_en: You are inherently worthy of love and respect, exactly as you are right now.
affirmations.text_es: Eres inherentemente digno de amor y respeto, exactamente como eres ahora.

affirmations.text_en: You are more than what you see in the mirror.
affirmations.text_es: Eres mucho más que lo que ves en el espejo.

affirmations.text_en: Your value as a person exists independent of your body.
affirmations.text_es: Tu valor como persona existe independiente de tu cuerpo.

affirmations.text_en: You don't have to earn your place in this world.
affirmations.text_es: No tienes que ganarte tu lugar en este mundo.

affirmations.text_en: Your thoughts and feelings matter, regardless of your body.
affirmations.text_es: Tus pensamientos y sentimientos importan, sin importar tu cuerpo.

affirmations.text_en: You are worthy of care and compassion simply because you exist.
affirmations.text_es: Mereces cuidado y compasión simplemente porque existes.

affirmations.text_en: Your worth is not a reflection in the mirror—it lives in your heart.
affirmations.text_es: Tu valor no es un reflejo en el espejo—vive en tu corazón.

affirmations.text_en: You are enough, without changing a single thing.
affirmations.text_es: Eres suficiente, sin cambiar ni una sola cosa.

affirmations.text_en: Your humanity is not conditional on meeting any standard.
affirmations.text_es: Tu humanidad no está condicionada a cumplir ningún estándar.

affirmations.text_en: You deserve to take up space in this world.
affirmations.text_es: Mereces ocupar espacio en este mundo.

affirmations.text_en: Your contributions to the world go far beyond your appearance.
affirmations.text_es: Tus contribuciones al mundo van mucho más allá de tu apariencia.

affirmations.text_en: You are not a 'before' or 'after'—you are a whole person, always.
affirmations.text_es: No eres un 'antes' ni un 'después'—eres una persona completa, siempre.

affirmations.text_en: Your worth cannot be measured or weighed.
affirmations.text_es: Tu valor no se puede medir ni pesar.

affirmations.text_en: You are deserving of kindness, especially from yourself.
affirmations.text_es: Mereces amabilidad, especialmente de ti mismo.

affirmations.text_en: Recovery is not linear, and that's completely okay.
affirmations.text_es: La recuperación no es lineal, y eso está completamente bien.

affirmations.text_en: Setbacks are part of the journey, not a sign of failure.
affirmations.text_es: Los retrocesos son parte del camino, no una señal de fracaso.

affirmations.text_en: You don't have to be perfect at recovery—progress matters more than perfection.
affirmations.text_es: No tienes que ser perfecto en la recuperación—el progreso importa más que la perfección.

affirmations.text_en: Having a hard day doesn't erase your progress.
affirmations.text_es: Tener un día difícil no borra tu progreso.

affirmations.text_en: Recovery has ups and downs—both are valid parts of healing.
affirmations.text_es: La recuperación tiene altos y bajos—ambos son partes válidas de la sanación.

affirmations.text_en: You're allowed to take recovery one moment at a time.
affirmations.text_es: Puedes tomar la recuperación un momento a la vez.

affirmations.text_en: Struggling doesn't mean you're moving backwards.
affirmations.text_es: Luchar no significa que estés retrocediendo.

affirmations.text_en: Some days will be harder than others, and that doesn't define your journey.
affirmations.text_es: Algunos días serán más difíciles que otros, y eso no define tu camino.

affirmations.text_en: Recovery doesn't have a timeline—your pace is valid.
affirmations.text_es: La recuperación no tiene un cronograma—tu ritmo es válido.

affirmations.text_en: You don't have to have it all figured out today.
affirmations.text_es: No tienes que tenerlo todo resuelto hoy.

affirmations.text_en: Your body deserves kindness, not criticism.
affirmations.text_es: Tu cuerpo merece amabilidad, no crítica.

affirmations.text_en: Your body is working hard to keep you alive—it deserves respect.
affirmations.text_es: Tu cuerpo está trabajando duro para mantenerte vivo—merece respeto.

affirmations.text_en: You can honor your body without loving every part of it.
affirmations.text_es: Puedes honrar tu cuerpo sin amar cada parte de él.

affirmations.text_en: Your body is not the enemy—it's been with you through everything.
affirmations.text_es: Tu cuerpo no es el enemigo—ha estado contigo en todo momento.

affirmations.text_en: Making peace with your body is a process, not a destination.
affirmations.text_es: Hacer las paces con tu cuerpo es un proceso, no un destino.

affirmations.text_en: Your body's worth is not determined by how it looks.
affirmations.text_es: El valor de tu cuerpo no está determinado por cómo se ve.

affirmations.text_en: It's okay to have complicated feelings about your body.
affirmations.text_es: Está bien tener sentimientos complicados sobre tu cuerpo.

affirmations.text_en: Your body carries you through life—that's worth acknowledging.
affirmations.text_es: Tu cuerpo te lleva a través de la vida—eso vale la pena reconocer.

affirmations.text_en: You don't owe anyone a certain body type or appearance.
affirmations.text_es: No le debes a nadie un tipo de cuerpo o apariencia específica.

affirmations.text_en: Your body is the least interesting thing about you.
affirmations.text_es: Tu cuerpo es lo menos interesante de ti.

affirmations.text_en: You deserve nourishment and care, unconditionally.
affirmations.text_es: Mereces nutrición y cuidado, incondicionalmente.

affirmations.text_en: Taking care of yourself is not selfish—it's necessary.
affirmations.text_es: Cuidarte no es egoísta—es necesario.

affirmations.text_en: You are allowed to rest without earning it.
affirmations.text_es: Puedes descansar sin tener que ganártelo.

affirmations.text_en: Listening to your body's needs is an act of self-respect.
affirmations.text_es: Escuchar las necesidades de tu cuerpo es un acto de respeto propio.

affirmations.text_en: Self-care looks different every day, and that's okay.
affirmations.text_es: El autocuidado se ve diferente cada día, y eso está bien.

affirmations.text_en: You deserve comfort and gentleness, especially on hard days.
affirmations.text_es: Mereces consuelo y ternura, especialmente en días difíciles.

affirmations.text_en: Meeting your needs is not weakness—it's wisdom.
affirmations.text_es: Satisfacer tus necesidades no es debilidad—es sabiduría.

affirmations.text_en: You're allowed to prioritize your wellbeing.
affirmations.text_es: Puedes priorizar tu bienestar.

affirmations.text_en: Caring for yourself is a radical act in a world that tells you not to.
affirmations.text_es: Cuidarte es un acto radical en un mundo que te dice que no lo hagas.

affirmations.text_en: You deserve to feel safe and cared for in your own life.
affirmations.text_es: Mereces sentirte seguro y cuidado en tu propia vida.

affirmations.text_en: Every day you choose recovery is a victory, no matter how small it feels.
affirmations.text_es: Cada día que eliges la recuperación es una victoria, sin importar cuán pequeña se sienta.

affirmations.text_en: It's okay to struggle—recovery is hard work.
affirmations.text_es: Está bien luchar—la recuperación es trabajo duro.

affirmations.text_en: You are stronger than you realize, even on days when you feel weak.
affirmations.text_es: Eres más fuerte de lo que crees, incluso en días cuando te sientes débil.

affirmations.text_en: Choosing to keep going, even when it's hard, is an act of courage.
affirmations.text_es: Elegir seguir adelante, incluso cuando es difícil, es un acto de valentía.

affirmations.text_en: You've survived every difficult day so far—that's proof of your strength.
affirmations.text_es: Has sobrevivido cada día difícil hasta ahora—esa es la prueba de tu fuerza.
